name: IDLIX
release_notes:
1. Enhanced Video & Movie Stream Detection: Background resolver extracts master .m3u8 playlists, .mp4 files, and subtitles directly from iframe player embeds without CORS limitations.
2. Built-in Dean Edwards JS Unpacker: Unpacks obfuscated player scripts on IDLIX and embed hosts.
3. Early Sniffer & Performance API Scanner: Hooks network calls before scripts run and inspects resource history so movie streams are never missed after ads.
